lines: If I were a freelance designer, this is the one automation I'd set up first.
Briefs come in by DM, email, a form, and you rebuild your to-do list every Monday.
When someone sends my Tally brief form, add a Trello card, create the project in Clockify, and message me on Telegram.
Every brief lands in one place, ready to track, before you've even opened it.
Join the waitlist — link in bio.
